newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RONALDO BOOED AS BARCELONA SCRAPE HOME WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO BOOED AS BARCELONA SCRAPE HOME WIN.

text.p: Barcelona closed on Spanish league leaders Real Madrid on Sunday with a scrappy 1-0 home win over Celta Vigo. Even Ronaldo was jeered.
Barcelona trail Real by two points and occupy second place on goal difference from Deportivo Coruna, who drew 1-1 at Sporting Gijon. Real returned from Valladolid on Saturday with the same result.

Barcelona's game did not prompt the demonstrations against club management which had been expected after a week of dressing room upheavals, but fans became unhappy when captain Gheorghe Popescu missed a first-half penalty. A goal by Miguel Angel Nadal sealed the points.

Other unhappy supporters could be found at Zaragoza -- languishing in the relegation zone after the 2-0 defeat by Racing Santander -- and Atletico Madrid, where followers carried banners criticising media treatment of their team. The Spanish champions fought back from 2-0 down to draw 2-2 with Real Sociedad.
